text:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing a lot of 413s for large embed requests after the routing change. Likely chunking mismatch. sample header: `X-Embed-Dims: 1536`
aj: yikes. Can you paste the raw request? Is it failing at preflight or at splitter?
maria: failing in preflight. console shows 'payload_bytes > route_quota' for consumer: acme-corp. Here's snippet:
```
{"model":"embed-large-v2","num_inputs":120,"total_bytes":6200000}
```
kevin: note that the new dim-negotiation heuristic prunes shapes > 1024 unless tenant opts-in; default route cap is 5MB. That explains it.
aj: so options: (1) expose per-tenant soft-cap override in console, (2) run preflight-to-split earlier so client gets 200 with split plan, (3) fallback to smaller model automatically. preference?
maria: preflight split earlier would be best UX — client gets deterministic plan and can stream chunks. But we need console telemetry to show when preflight suggested splitting vs when we auto-reject. :eyes: 
kevin: agree. We should add a metric: embed.preflight.suggested_splits (count, by tenant/model/dim), and a tag embed.preflight.action_taken = [suggested, auto_split, rejected]. Also emit route_quota_bytes and requested_bytes per event.
aj: also need a roll out flag: `embed.dim_negotiation_v2` so we can A/B test. Can we wire console to show % of traffic on v2 and per-route failure rate?
ci-bot: created feature flag `embed.dim_negotiation_v2` in launchdarkly. default: off for existing tenants, on for internal dev orgs.
opsbot: deploy to canary cluster started by @ci-bot. build: infra/embeds:pr-451. status: 3/4 pods healthy.
maria: i'll add a tiny telemetry dashboard mock and post it. Also will open a tiny RFC for the UI change (ENG-2891). tagging @qa for compatibility tests.
kevin: for API change, let's prefer preflight response format: 200 with `suggested_split_plan` in `X-Embed-Preflight` header as JSON string. example: `X-Embed-Preflight: {"chunks":3,"chunk_size":2048}`
aj: minimal client change — good. just ensure header size small. we can compress base64 if needed.
maria: filed ENG-2891, added test matrix and console mock link. I'll follow up on telemetry naming. Thanks all :thumbsup:
